questions.q: Which rule suggests setting three daily, weekly, and yearly goals?
questions.why: Chris Bailey introduced the Rule of 3 in his book.

questions.q: What did Chris find when testing 20 to 90 work hours per week?
questions.why: He observed similar productivity between 20 and 90 hours.

questions.q: According to the book, what happens after 60 work hours weekly?
questions.why: Chris noted tasks take twice as long after 60 hours.

questions.q: Which energy type is missing when you are old?
questions.why: The analogy says old age has money and time but no energy.

questions.q: What is the main benefit of a to-do list in productivity?
questions.why: The text says a to-do list taps the subconscious to motivate.
